resources.string: Commitments, schedules, and what actually happened.
Reminders create in-app receipts. Human review jobs wait for your explicit acknowledgement. Jobs do not yet send email, run AI or coding tasks, or control a browser or desktop.
Automatic scheduling is unavailable. Use a manual job and Run now.
Create a reminder or a human review checkpoint. Every run keeps its own receipt.
No matching jobs in the loaded pages. Change the filter or load more jobs.
Up to %1$d recent runs are kept; long receipts can reduce that number. A queued run has not completed its work.
No runs yet. Run this job now, or wait for its scheduled time.
Older runs are loaded. Use Refresh to include new runs.
Editing, pausing, or cancelling also cancels pending reviews. Recurrence skips nonexistent clock-change times and uses the first occurrence of a repeated time.
Your edits are kept. Load the latest version to replace them, or close and review the job.
This records your acknowledgement of the saved checkpoint below. It does not send messages or execute external work.
Create another attempt of the saved checkpoint below. A human review still needs a separate approval.
This cancels the selected run. The job’s future schedule stays as it is.
Stop future runs and cancel pending checkpoints. Its history stays available.
Stop future runs and cancel pending checkpoints. You can resume the job later.
Job created. Review its next run and history.
Changes saved. Pending reviews were cancelled; existing receipts keep their original contents.
Action recorded. Check the run receipt for the outcome.
Enter a title up to 160 UTF-8 bytes. Some characters use more than one byte.
Enter notes up to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes. Some characters use more than one byte.
Choose a valid date, time and day of week.
This time does not exist because the clock changes. Choose another time.
This time occurs twice when the clock changes. Choose an unambiguous time, or use UTC.
Choose a future time, or use Manual only.
Your access could not be verified. Sign in again or check your account permissions.
This job or run is no longer available. Refresh the list.
This job changed or the action is no longer available. Refresh and review its latest version.
The pending-run limit was reached. Resolve or cancel a pending review and try again.
The job could not be saved. Check its title, notes and schedule.
Jobs are unavailable on this server. Your input is kept; try again when service is restored.
The outcome could not be confirmed. Your input is kept. Retry the same request, or refresh to check its receipt.
This job was cancelled and can no longer be edited. Close the editor and refresh.
